'''2007 New Jersey State Championship Greg Shaw LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2007 New Jersey State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' In the Name of RoFL Monster
* '''Username:''' stealtheblind
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
